workspace_purpose: End-to-end correction-chain demo on one real citation claim (AAAI 2017, open-access venue-of-record via DOI + AAAI OJS).
trusted_proxy_justification: This machine routes all egress through its own local relay at 127.0.0.1:7890 (system-wide proxy); strict peer attestation is unusable behind a local relay per docs/citation-verification.md section 6. The allowlist is restricted to the DOI authority routes plus ojs.aaai.org, the DOI landing redirect target.
